font: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

mono.$comment: Greyscale conversion for SVGs produced by other tools. overrides = exact colour swaps (keys are source colours); every other colour is mapped by 'ramp' (categorical, in order of appearance) or 'luma' (brightness, stretched into range); strategy may be { hex, rgb } to treat the two colour notations differently. font = swap the font for the theme monospace.
